subject.title: Feature request: first-class .env / environment-backed secret config UX

question: What SecretRef source metadata may Control UI expose for env-backed secrets, and should env variable names or resolved/unresolved state be shown by default?
rationale: The requested UX improves secret hygiene, but exposing environment variable names, provider aliases, or resolution state can reveal operator setup details, so automation should not choose that disclosure boundary alone.

options.title: Approve Conservative Source-Aware UX
options.body: Show masked `config`/`env`/`unset` state and resolved/unresolved status, with env variable names shown only where maintainers accept that disclosure.

options.title: Minimal Read-Only Badge
options.body: Replace generic structured placeholders with a safe `SecretRef configured` badge and keep editing in Raw/CLI until a larger design is approved.

options.title: Defer UI Disclosure
options.body: Keep current UI behavior and improve docs/CLI guidance only until security review defines the metadata policy.

recommendation.title: Approve Conservative Source-Aware UX
recommendation.body: Show masked `config`/`env`/`unset` state and resolved/unresolved status, with env variable names shown only where maintainers accept that disclosure.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is primarily a SecretRef metadata disclosure and credential-handling boundary, and Josh has the strongest merged history on the underlying SecretRef contracts.
